files.html:
0.2.0 Change Log

  • Improved Popup Maker command structure
  • Unified show and stop command formats
  • Added support for entering titles and subtitles directly through comman
  • Fixed NPC bulk purchases bypassing item stack limits, which also caused issues such as Quark sorting resetting stacked items to 1.
